cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor Laboratory to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The Assistant Supervisor will be responsible for assisting the Supervisor in managing and improving a dynamic inventory/order fulfillment system in a high volume, fast-paced environment. Will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and a minimum wastage of consumables working in tangent and support of the Supervisor. Responsibilities this position includes are cleaning, QC'ing and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers.
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing of section staff.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment).
Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves.
Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools, mechanically inclined
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers whenever necessary in order to meet deadlines
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turn-around times
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision
Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team
Must be reliable, adaptable, willing to learn
Strong, positive leadership
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office
Have some flexibility regarding schedule - irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends, when necessary
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
0 - 3 Years of laboratory experience
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
Ability to use (or learn to use) Laboratory Information Management System
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.)
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required
Physical Demands:
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients. Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day. Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment.

cond_0026.intro: The Assistant Supervisor will own the management and improvement of an inventory/order fulfillment system in a high volume environment. You will meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables, taking charge of cleaning, QC'ing, and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
Ensure equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Direct and oversee staff within the section.
Ensure all duties within the section are executed in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Set priorities for work received in the section.
Lead training and development of section staff.
Execute routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners, and ovens.
Monitor equipment/instrument performance, identify deviations from specifications, and notify the Laboratory Manager when equipment and/or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC falls outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers and repair canister valves.
Take direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Master all procedures performed in the department and ensure they comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintain documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigate and resolve anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0026.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers to meet deadlines
Must be able to perform duties effectively under pressure from large sample volumes and short turnaround times
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision
Must be organized, detail oriented, able to take direction, and work well with a team
Must be reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn
Strong, positive leadership
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office
Ability to use (or learn to use) a Laboratory Information Management System
Some schedule flexibility — irregular hours, overtime, and/or weekends are sometimes requested
Physical ability to speak and hear clearly, sit and/or stand for an 8-hour day, and operate computers, syringes, and other equipment with hand/finger dexterity
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
0–3 Years of laboratory experience

The Assistant Supervisor will work closely with the Supervisor on a daily basis, helping to manage and improve an inventory and order fulfillment system in a high-volume setting. You will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables, staying in regular contact with the Supervisor and section staff throughout.
cond_0051.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section and staying actively engaged with their day-to-day work.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing section staff, with regular hands-on communication and guidance.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens.
Monitoring equipment and instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications, and promptly notifying the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC falls outside control limits.
Cleaning sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrating flow controllers and repairing canister valves.
Taking direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning, and actively communicating progress and issues.
Learning all procedures performed in the department and ensuring these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies, raising issues early and connecting with relevant staff to resolve them.
Performing housekeeping duties as required.
Controlling consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0051.requirements:
Strong, positive leadership.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with staff, management, and clients on a regular basis.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance, and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances).
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implementing improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and actively connect with co-workers whenever necessary to meet deadlines.
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turnaround times.
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use (or learn to use) a Laboratory Information Management System.
Must be organized, detail oriented, able to take positive direction, and work well with a team.
Have some flexibility regarding schedule — irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends when necessary.
Must be reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn.
AA required; BS preferred.
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement is a strong plus.
Prior shipping/warehouse work is a plus.
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined.
0–3 Years of laboratory experience preferred.
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients.
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day.
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment.

cond_0105.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor to join our laboratory team. The Assistant Supervisor will work closely with the Supervisor on a daily basis, helping to manage and improve an inventory and order fulfillment system in a high-volume setting. You will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables, staying in regular contact with the Supervisor and section staff throughout.
cond_0105.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section and staying actively engaged with their day-to-day work.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing section staff, with regular hands-on communication and guidance.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens.
Monitoring equipment and instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications, and promptly notifying the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC falls outside control limits.
Cleaning sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrating flow controllers and repairing canister valves.
Taking direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning, and actively communicating progress and issues.
Learning all procedures performed in the department and ensuring these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies, raising issues early and connecting with relevant staff to resolve them.
Performing housekeeping duties as required.
Controlling consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0105.requirements:
Strong, positive leadership.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with staff, management, and clients on a regular basis.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance, and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances).
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implementing improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and actively connect with co-workers whenever necessary to meet deadlines.
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turnaround times.
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use (or learn to use) a Laboratory Information Management System.
Must be organized, detail oriented, able to take positive direction, and work well with a team.
Have some flexibility regarding schedule — irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends when necessary.
Must be reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn.
AA required; BS preferred.
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement is a strong plus.
Prior shipping/warehouse work is a plus.
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined.
0–3 Years of laboratory experience preferred.
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients.
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day.
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment.

cond_0149.intro: The Assistant Supervisor will be responsible for assisting the Supervisor in managing and improving a dynamic inventory/order fulfillment system in a high volume environment. Will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and a minimum wastage of consumables working in tangent and support of the Supervisor. Responsibilities this position includes are cleaning, QC'ing and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing of section staff.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment)
Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers
Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves
Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning
Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
About you:
Strong, positive leadership
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.)
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers whenever necessary in order to meet deadlines.
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turn-around times.
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use (or learn to use) Laboratory Information Management System.
Must be able to work well in a fast-paced environment
Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team
Have some flexibility regarding schedule - irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends, when necessary.
Must be reliable, adaptable, willing to learn
cond_0149.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools, mechanically inclined
Must be able to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
0 - 3 Years of laboratory experience

cond_0232.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor to support the Supervisor in managing and improving an inventory and order fulfillment system at a high volume laboratory. The role involves meeting daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables. Core tasks include cleaning, QC'ing, and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers.
cond_0232.responsibilities:
Ensure equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Oversee staff within the section.
Ensure all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritize work received for the section.
Train and develop section staff.
Perform routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners, and ovens.
Monitor equipment and instrument performance, identify deviations from specifications, and notify the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC results fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers and repair canister valves.
Take direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Learn all procedures performed in the department and ensure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintain documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument and method logs.
Investigate and rectify anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0232.requirements:
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Written communication skills and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Ensure the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensure instrument repairs, maintenance, and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances).
Assess results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Able to initiate corrective action without prompting and support co-workers as needed to meet deadlines.
Able to perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turnaround times.
Able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use, or learn to use, a Laboratory Information Management System.
Organized, detail oriented, able to take direction, and work within a team.
Some flexibility regarding schedule — irregular hours, overtime, and weekends are sometimes required.
Reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn.
AA required; BS preferred.
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement is a strong plus.
Prior shipping or warehouse work is a plus.
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined.
0–3 Years of laboratory experience preferred.
Ability to communicate clearly with staff and management.
Ability to sit and/or stand for the duration of an 8-hour day.
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate a computer, syringes, and other equipment.

cond_0240.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor to join our laboratory team. The role involves working closely with the Supervisor to manage and improve an inventory and order fulfillment system in a high-volume environment. Day-to-day work includes cleaning, QC-ing, and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers, meeting daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal waste of consumables.
cond_0240.responsibilities:
Ensure equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Oversee and regularly communicate with staff within the section.
Ensure all duties are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritize work received for the section.
Train and develop section staff through ongoing interaction and guidance.
Perform routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners, and ovens.
Monitor equipment and instrument performance; identify deviations from specifications and promptly notify the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instrument QC falls outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers and repair canister valves.
Take direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Learn all procedures performed in the department and ensure they comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintain documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigate and rectify anomalies, actively raising issues early to resolve them.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0240.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills — comfortable communicating regularly with staff, co-workers, and management
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office
Ability to initiate corrective action without prompting and actively support co-workers to meet deadlines
Ability to perform duties effectively under pressure from large sample volumes and short turnaround times
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn
Some schedule flexibility — irregular hours, overtime, or weekends may occasionally be requested
Strong, positive leadership
Ability to use (or learn to use) a Laboratory Information Management System
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate a computer, syringes, and other equipment
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
0–3 Years of laboratory experience
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
Ability to ensure instrument repairs, maintenance, and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances)
Experience assessing QA/QC audit results and implementing improvements
Ability to ensure quality of the lab meets or exceeds QC targets set out in the QC manual

The Assistant Supervisor will be responsible for assisting the Supervisor in managing and improving a dynamic inventory/order fulfillment system in a high volume, fast-paced environment. Will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and a minimum wastage of consumables working in tangent and support of the Supervisor. Responsibilities this position includes are cleaning, QC'ing and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers.
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy. Overseeing staff within the section. Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual. Prioritizing the work received for the section. Training and developing of section staff. Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment) Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits. Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices. Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs. Investigating and rectifying anomalies. Perform housekeeping duties as required. Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed. Other duties as assigned.
About you:
Strong, positive leadership Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail Proficient verbal and written communication skills. Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual. Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.) Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required. Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office. Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers whenever necessary in order to meet deadlines. Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turn-around times. Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision. Ability to use (or learn to use) Laboratory Information Management System. Must be able to work well in a fast-paced environment Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team Have some flexibility regarding schedule - irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends, when necessary. Must be reliable, adaptable, willing to learn
cond_0309.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree (AA) in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to use basic hand tools; some mechanical aptitude is helpful
Comfort with computer use, including working knowledge of Microsoft Office
Willingness to learn a Laboratory Information Management System if not already familiar
Ability to communicate effectively, work with a team, and take direction
Openness to feedback and a willingness to grow in the role
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BS) in a related field
Around 0–3 years of laboratory experience, though candidates with less background are welcome to apply
Background in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or process improvement
Prior shipping or warehouse experience
Physical Demands
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients. Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day. Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment.
cond_0309.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
cond_0309.workplace_support: Our workplace is designed to support different ways of working and different stages of life and career. We provide flexibility so employees can do their best work while balancing collaboration, wellbeing, and personal responsibilities.

cond_0310.intro: The Assistant Supervisor will be responsible for assisting the Supervisor in managing and improving a dynamic inventory/order fulfillment system in a high volume environment. Will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and a minimum wastage of consumables working in tangent and support of the Supervisor. Responsibilities this position includes are cleaning, QC'ing and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of laboratory and equipment processes the work involves.
cond_0310.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing of section staff.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment).
Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves.
Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
About you:
Strong, positive leadership.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.).
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers whenever necessary in order to meet deadlines.
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turn-around times.
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use (or learn to use) Laboratory Information Management System.
Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team.
Have some flexibility regarding schedule - irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends, when necessary.
Must be reliable, adaptable, willing to learn.
cond_0310.requirements:

AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools, mechanically inclined
Must be able to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
0 - 3 Years of laboratory experience

Responsibilities this position includes are cleaning, QC'ing and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of laboratory and equipment management work involved.
cond_0319.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing of section staff.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment)
Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers
Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves
Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning
Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
About you:
Strong, positive leadership
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.)
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.
Must be able to initiate corrective action without prompting and assist co-workers whenever necessary in order to meet deadlines.
Must be able to effectively perform duties under pressures arising from large sample volumes and short turn-around times.
Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to use (or learn to use) Laboratory Information Management System.
Must be able to work well in a fast-paced environment
Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team
Have some flexibility regarding schedule - irregular hours are sometimes requested, as well as some overtime and/or weekends, when necessary.
Must be reliable, adaptable, willing to learn
cond_0319.requirements:
AA required, BS preferred
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering and/or process improvement a strong plus.
Prior shipping/warehouse work is a plus.
Ability to use basic hand tools, mechanically inclined
0 - 3 Years of laboratory experience is preferred.
The ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients.
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day.
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate computer, syringes, and other equipment.
cond_0319.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
cond_0319.workplace_support: Our workplace is designed to support different ways of working and different stages of life and career. We provide flexibility so employees can do their best work while balancing collaboration, wellbeing, and personal responsibilities.

Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section.

Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens (equipment)
Monitoring equipment/instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications and notifying Laboratory Manager if the equipment and/or instrument are not operating to specifications, including when equipment/instrument QC fall outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment - this involves the use of vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, basic hand tools like wrenches and pliers
Calibrate flow controllers, repair canister valves
Take direction from Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning
Learn all procedures performed in the department and insure these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
About you:
Strong, positive leadership
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
Ensuring the quality of the lab is maintained at the level that meets or exceeds the QC targets set out in the QC manual.
Ensuring instrument repairs, maintenance and calibration schedules are carried out (e.g. Ovens, balances etc.)
Assessing results of QA/QC audits and implement improvements as required.
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office.

Must be organized, detail oriented, be able to take positive direction, work with a team

Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering and/or process improvement a strong plus.

cond_0447.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor to join our laboratory team. The Assistant Supervisor will work closely with the Supervisor on a daily basis, helping to manage and improve an inventory and order fulfillment system in a high-volume setting. You will need to meet daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables, staying in regular contact with the Supervisor and section staff throughout.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Ensuring that equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Overseeing staff within the section and staying actively engaged with their day-to-day work.
Ensuring all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritizing the work received for the section.
Training and developing section staff, with regular hands-on communication and guidance.
Routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners and ovens.
Monitoring equipment and instrument performance, identifying deviations from specifications, and promptly notifying the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC falls outside control limits.
Cleaning sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrating flow controllers and repairing canister valves.
Taking direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning, and actively communicating progress and issues.
Learning all procedures performed in the department and ensuring these procedures comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintaining documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigating and rectifying anomalies, raising issues early and connecting with relevant staff to resolve them.
Performing housekeeping duties as required.
Controlling consumable stock required for the tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.

cond_0565.intro: We are looking for an Assistant Supervisor Laboratory to join our team. The Assistant Supervisor will assist the Supervisor in managing and improving an inventory/order fulfillment system in a high-volume environment. The role requires meeting daily deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and minimal wastage of consumables. Core tasks include cleaning, QC'ing, and shipping laboratory sampling equipment to customers.
cond_0565.responsibilities:
Ensure equipment orders are fulfilled daily with a high degree of accuracy.
Oversee staff within the section.
Ensure all duties within the section are conducted in accordance with the Quality Procedures Manual.
Prioritize work received for the section.
Train and develop section staff.
Perform routine maintenance of vacuum pumps, conditioners, and ovens.
Monitor equipment and instrument performance; identify deviations from specifications and notify the Laboratory Manager when equipment or instruments are not operating to specifications, including when QC falls outside control limits.
Clean sampling equipment using vacuum pressure manifolds, ovens, and basic hand tools such as wrenches and pliers.
Calibrate flow controllers and repair canister valves.
Take direction from the Supervisor regarding equipment maintenance and canister cleaning.
Learn all procedures performed in the department and ensure they comply with SOPs and good laboratory practices.
Maintain documentation of samples, standards, reports, and instrument/method logs.
Investigate and rectify anomalies.
Perform housekeeping duties as required.
Control consumable stock required for tasks performed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0565.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
AA degree
Ability to use basic hand tools; mechanically inclined
Able to perform duties under pressure from large sample volumes and short turnaround times
Able to work independently with minimal supervision
Organized and detail oriented; able to take direction and coordinate with team members on task completion
Reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn
Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Flexibility regarding schedule — irregular hours, overtime, and/or weekends are sometimes required
Preferred Requirements:
BS degree
0–3 Years of laboratory experience
Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, and/or process improvement
Prior shipping/warehouse work
Ability to use (or learn to use) a Laboratory Information Management System
Physical Demands:
Ability to speak and hear clearly while communicating with staff, management, and clients
Ability to sit and/or stand for 100% of an 8-hour day
Dexterity in hands and fingers to operate a computer, syringes, and other equipment
